item.text: {"cost_regression":false,"evidence":{"O1":{"citation":"Pass: “One passing run is evidence, not proof” and “It should not claim universal reliability from a single successful run.”","status":"pass"},"O2":{"citation":"Fail: The artifact requires fresh, context-free repetitions and says to “Record pass/fail per case,” but never requires calculating or reporting per-case pass rates.","status":"fail"},"O3":{"citation":"Pass: “the fresh runner saw only the case input, never the expected outcome; the judge saw only the artifact, the bar, and the skill’s first principles.”","status":"pass"},"O4":{"citation":"Fail: It says “Map failures to skill defects” and “rerun the entire sweep blindly,” but does not require distinguishing actual skill defects from invalid or bad cases.","status":"fail"},"O5":{"citation":"Fail: The claim is deferred until “consistent blind passes across a defensible sweep,” but the artifact does not explicitly require repeated per-case pass rates or preservation and comparison of before-and-after evidence.","status":"fail"},"S1":{"citation":"Smell absent: The artifact explicitly says, “One passing run is evidence, not proof.”","status":"pass"},"S2":{"citation":"Smell absent: “Only after consistent blind passes across a defensible sweep should the guidebook make a scoped claim.”","status":"pass"},"S3":{"citation":"Smell present: Repeated blind trials are required, but per-case pass rates are omitted; only “Record pass/fail per case” appears.","status":"fail"},"S4":{"citation":"Smell absent: The runner sees “only the case input, never the expected outcome,” while the judge receives the bar.","status":"pass"},"S5":{"citation":"Smell absent: It requires mapping failures and revising “only where the evidence supports it” before rerunning.","status":"pass"}},"passed":false,"rationale":"The artifact correctly treats one green run as provisional, preserves runner/judge separation, repeats blind trials, and defers any scoped claim.
